Matches user-agent specific rules in robots.txt

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'respect_robots_txt' => true, 'user_agent' => 'CrawlbergBot' }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.is_allowed.inspect
```
